production_runner_baseline.head: 1afa3e30f1de5e0192be6240a3754c89e2eb6f25
production_runner_baseline.legacy_route: unchanged; the above 12 IDs still use the original frozen per-case authority, path/hash/provenance validator, and versioned dispatch_once contract

k6_geometry.ordered_geometry: exactly six finite positive values D1 through D6 in declared order; preserve canonical array order

geometry_source.eligibility_rule: The exact case_id and ordered D1...D6 vector must be present in an owner-controlled, immutable source authority referenced by the versioned dispatch envelope. Do not infer eligibility from numeric ranges or from a matching geometry hash alone. If a new source authority replaces or extends the pinned expansion, its exact file hash must be explicitly bound in the admission authority.

must_remain_identical_to_base: physical contract bytes and semantic content
monitor set, positions, sampling, references, and de-embedding
all launcher, GPU, persistence, postprocessing, and truth-validation settings
not_science_fields: per-case authority/source manifest path and hash
per-case source/staged FSP path and hash
per-case pre-entry LOAD proof path and hash
k6_geometry.fingerprint_rule: Compute a new resolved setup contract fingerprint for every case from case class, case_id, attempt_id, ordered_D_nm, byte-level physical contract SHA256, and canonical semantic physical-contract SHA256. The physical contract hash must remain equal to the pinned production contract for this route; the resolved setup fingerprint and all case provenance/FSP hashes are case-specific.

base_setup_invariants: mesh implementation and solver stopping rule
all existing monitors including historical POSTNP
launcher, GPU, persistence, postprocessing, and truth-validation settings

added_monitor.name: EXT02_POSTNP_DIAG_Z2000
added_monitor.sampling_policy: copy the existing POSTNP interpolation, downsampling, and coordinate policy exactly
added_monitor.actual_sampled_z_nm: must be measured from the materialized setup/result and recorded; do not substitute nominal_z_nm
added_monitor.local_mesh_spacing: must be recorded from the actual materialized mesh/result; not established by this offline design

ext02_diagnostic.hash_rule: The proposal reference hash is design metadata only. Compute and persist the actual diagnostic physical contract byte hash and semantic fingerprint from the materialized contract. Both must be distinct from the old production contract; never write the old contract SHA into the diagnostic manifest.
forbidden: any geometry, material, source, polarization, wavelength, boundary, mesh, stopping-rule, normalization, reference-plane, or launcher change
using the historical 2 nm/seed FSP as the new 5 nm setup
treating the proposal fingerprint as the actual setup or contract hash

required_artifacts: resolved setup contract JSON and byte hash
actual physical contract JSON and byte hash
case provenance source manifest and byte hash
pre-entry setup LOAD-only proof and byte hash
path_rules: one immutable authority root/case_id/attempt_id directory per attempt
all case-local artifacts resolve under that exact case/attempt directory
only the owner-pinned geometry/diagnostic source authority may be referenced outside the case directory
reject missing files, path traversal, symlinks, unexpected manifest keys, duplicate JSON keys, and hash mismatches
source FSP and staged FSP byte hashes must match exactly

required_before_dispatch: case class and identity are authorized by the versioned admission authority
a fresh case-specific setup/contract/source manifest is materialized and content-hashed
the exact staged FSP is produced and byte-compared to its source FSP
a pre-entry LOAD-only readback passes on that exact staged FSP with solver_run_called=false and scientific_entry_count=0
the dispatch envelope binds the new manifest, contract, FSP, provenance, and LOAD-proof hashes
not_required_before_first_solver_entry: post-entry truth recovery from a prior run
a historical NATIVE_TRUTH_DURABLE record for this never-run case
a prior scientific result or prior attempt's fresh LOAD proof
first_admission.proof_semantics: Pre-entry LOAD-only proof establishes that this new staged setup loads and reads back the declared settings. It is not a scientific truth result. After a single solver entry, the unchanged post-entry path must separately establish GPU process lineage, durable FSP/H5, fresh LOAD truth recovery, SCIENTIFIC_VALID, completion barrier, truth-before-DONE, and RELEASED.
